result.coreMessage: Discovery through a playful home tasting: brew two cups, search for dark cherry and cocoa, and compare the first cup with the last.
result.hook: Kan du finde kirsebær og kakao?
result.hookEn: Can you find cherry and cocoa?
result.visualDirection: Overhead close-up photograph on a light wooden kitchen table: two small cups of black coffee side by side, a small ceramic dish with dark cherries and a pinch of cocoa powder beside them, one hand lifting a cup, soft morning daylight from the side, shallow depth of field, no packaging, no text, no letters visible.
result.headlineDa: Lav et lille smageforsøg i dit køkken
result.headlineEn: Run a little tasting test in your kitchen
result.primaryTextDa: Tag to kopper fra samme pose. Find først mørk kirsebær. Så kakao. Skriv ikke noget ned. Drik første kop frisk. Gem legen til sidste kop. Smag igen. Hvad har flyttet sig?
result.primaryTextEn: Take two cups from the same bag. Find dark cherry first. Then cocoa. Write nothing down. Drink the first cup fresh. Save the game for the last cup. Taste again. What has shifted?
